zusage.start.z-friedensprozess: The MHP was promised a say in the peace process
zusage.start.z-renten: Pension increase promised within the first hundred days
zusage.start.z-vergaben: Open tenders and asset declarations promised
zusage.eu.justizreform: The EU was promised a judicial reform
zusage.gesetz.erreicht: The promised target has been reached or adopted nationwide. The promise is now fulfilled; recognition has been credited once.
zusage.gesetz.laeuft: A bill on this measure is already before parliament. The promise remains open until a qualifying decision is adopted.
zusage.gesetz.eingebracht: The bill has been introduced. The promise remains open; loyalty and willingness increase only when the promised target is adopted nationwide.
zusage.gesetz.belohnung: This recognition is credited once when the promised target is met. Introducing, withdrawing or rejecting a bill grants no promise bonus.
zusage.gesetz.beschlossen: The promised target has been adopted nationwide. The promise bonus and credibility have now been credited; implementation continues.
zusage.gesetz.offen.text: Promised: {name} nationwide at level {ziel}. Introducing the bill costs {pk} PC; personal and political recognition follows only upon fulfilment.
zusage.gesetz.beratung.text: Vote on {datum}, bill at level {stufe}. The promised target remains {ziel}.
zusage.gesetz.deckt: If passed, this bill fulfils the promise. Implementation follows afterwards.
zusage.gesetz.teil: This bill is insufficient: it does not meet the agreed target nationwide. The promise stays open even if it passes.
zusage.gesetz.bereit.text: The target has been reached or already adopted nationwide. You can record fulfilment now without introducing another bill.
zusage.gesetz.fristRegel: A nationwide bill that meets the pledge allows time until 15 days after the scheduled vote. An existing later pledge deadline is kept. Partial bills and failed attempts do not postpone the deadline.
zusage.gesetz.fristLog: Time for deliberation on “{zusage}”: the new pledge deadline is {datum}, 15 days after the scheduled vote on {votum}. The pledge remains open.
